newsitem.title: USA: MMI Cos sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: MMI Cos sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: MMI Cos Inc said Tuesday that its board approved adoption of a shareholder rights plan, declaring a dividend distribution of one right to buy 1/100 share of preferred stock on each outstanding common share.

The company said the rights are exercisable when someone tries to buy more than 15 percent of its common stock. Under such circumstances, each right would enable its holder to buy $150 worth of MMI common stock for $75.

If MMI is acquired in a deal not approved by the board, each right would enable the holder to buy common stock of the acquiring company with a market value equal to two times the exercise price of the right, a purchase value of $150 of the common stock of the acquring company for $75.
The dividend distribution is payable to shareholders of record June 30. The rights will expire in 10 years, MMI said.
MMI, an international healthcare risk management company, said the rights plan was not adopted in response to any take-over bid or threatened proposal from a third party.
